[[Vetaura's Harbinger]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] obtained from opening a [[Zaishen Strongbox]]. It is wielded by [[Messenger Vetaura]].

==Stats==
: [[Slashing damage|Slashing Dmg]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]])
: [[Damage]] +15% (while Health is above 50%)
: [[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
: [[Enchantments]] last 20% longer

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Envoy Scythe]].

== Replica ==
It is possible to create an exact technical and visual replica for this item with:
*[[Envoy Scythe]] from [[Jessie Llam]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*Perfect [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Enchanting]]
*Perfect "[[Strength and Honor]]" inscription
